text:
elin: Quick design check-in — proposal to decouple the realtime billing fast-path from the audit trail. idea: emit a compact "billing_event" for low-latency credits and a richer append-only "audit_event" written to the canonical ledger asynchronously. sketch below. thoughts?
samir: TLDR yes if we keep deterministic attribution in the async path. otherwise recon becomes impossible.
jessica: curious about semantics — do we accept eventual consistency for customer-facing credit visibility? SLA implications?
elin: good q. proposal: realtime path guarantees customer-visible balances within 200ms but marked as provisional. final authoritative state comes from audit_event reconciliation (background job). UI shows provisional badge until reconciliation.
kai: risk: double-counting during reconciliation if we don't carry stable provenance keys. we need an attribution fingerprint that survives retries and fanout.
elin: agreed. thinking of attaching a stable `origin_fingerprint` + `attempt_id` to both events. code sketch:```json
{
  "billing_event": {
    "tenant_id": "t123",
    "units": 120,
    "model": "gptx-small",
    "origin_fingerprint": "sha256(reqroot+user+seed)",
    "provisional": true,
    "trace_id": "tx-..."
  }
}
```
jessica: That helps. how do we handle late-arrivals? e.g., chunked requests where final token count changes after realtime op returned?
samir: we should treat realtime as optimistic increment and have reconciliation generate compensating events. audit_event should include final token counts + an `epoch` sequence so we can compute delta.
elin: exact. audit_event schema:```json
{
  "audit_event": {
    "tenant_id": "t123",
    "final_units": 140,
    "billing_event_ref": "tx-...",
    "origin_fingerprint": "...",
    "epoch": 42,
    "trace": [...],
    "auditor_signature": "..."
  }
}
```
kai: operational concern: this doubles write paths and storage. plan for retention and tiering?
elin: plan: short-retention fast-path (7d) stored in hot KV for quick rollbacks, audit_event goes to cold append-only ledger (90-365d per compliance). billing reconciler consumes ledger and emits final commit records to the canonical accounting store.
jessica: who owns the reconciler? product needs SLA on how long provisional shows.
elin: ownership: eng-platform owns reconciler code, product owns cert for UX SLA. default provisional TTL 24h, enterprise can tighten.
samir: can we avoid global coordination by sharding reconciliation by tenant and using monotonic epoch per tenant? keeps latency down and avoids cross-tenant locking.
elin: yeah shard by tenant_id; use per-tenant epoch monotonic counter persisted in ledger. race scenarios: two auditors running concurrently for same tenant — require CAS on epoch counter.
kai: CAS contention could spike for noisy tenants. fallback: queue per-tenant or leaky-bucket rate limit reconciliation. also, move heavy work to async workers with backoff.
jessica: audit trails must be queryable for disputes. what indexes? by tenant + origin_fingerprint + time. also need ability to reconstruct history for a given fingerprint.
elin: agreed. ledger rows: tenant_id, origin_fingerprint, epoch, final_units, created_at, source_trace. index on (tenant_id, origin_fingerprint) and time-range.
metering-bot: deploy-check: New DB table `audit_ledger_v2` will be created in staging on Mon 09:00 UTC. PR: https://git.redwood/infraproj/1234
samir: one more: how do we reconcile when model variant fallback occurs (realtime charged for variant A, audit shows B)? origin_fingerprint must include model hints and we need mapping rules.
elin: reconciliation rules: prefer audit_event.model when present. if model differs, create adjustment event with reason 'fallback-model'. Notify customer and surface in console.
kai: alerting: create SLO for reconciliation success rate and delta magnitude. send alerts when >0.5% tenants have >10% negative adjustments in 24h.
jessica: migration plan? existing pipeline writes only billing_event. we need a compatibility shim that also writes audit_event for new requests for 30d, then flip reconciler to trust audit_event.
elin: propose phased rollout: 1) shim writes both paths in staging 2) reconcile simulator run on prod traffic in dry-run mode 3) enable reconciler commit for small tenant subset 4) full rollout.
samir: agree. please add canary plan with sample tenants across noise spectrum.
elin: will draft runbook and PR. thanks all. :thumbsup:
kai: small nit — add a non-repudiation header for enterprise customers (HSM-signed) if compliance requires.
elin: noted. adding enterprise-only `auditor_signature` via KMS.
jessica: awesome. last Q: billing reports downstream (invoicing) should always use reconciled totals. mark that in docs.
elin: documented. I'll open RFC follow-up with schemas, migration steps, and runbook link.
samir: +1 on RFC follow-up.
metering-bot: audit-guard: reminder: add unit tests for idempotency and reconcile delta generator.
elin: on it. will tag you in the PR.
